title: Two service accounts both claim to be UID 1301
description_md:
A provisioning script created a new service account, `metricsagent`, and it accidentally got the same UID (1301) as the existing, unrelated `logshipper` account. Now `ls -l`/`getent passwd 1301` shows everything as `logshipper` no matter which account actually owns it, and nobody can tell the two apart by name -- a real identity-confusion incident waiting to cause an ownership mistake. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), untangle the two accounts so each has its own unique UID, without breaking either account or its files.

You're done when `logshipper` and `metricsagent` are distinct accounts with distinct UIDs, and each still owns its own home directory correctly.
